subject.title: feat(mcp): open App views from channel replies

question: Should channel replies be allowed to expose a short-lived MCP App launch capability through internet-reachable Tailscale Funnel origins, or should this feature initially remain tailnet-only?
rationale: The implementation deliberately converts a private in-process App view into a URL that can be delivered through third-party channel recipients; the acceptable audience and public-exposure policy cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Land tailnet-only first
options.body: Permit the action only for Tailscale Serve and defer Funnel delivery until owners define the public-recipient security contract.

options.title: Approve Funnel delivery
options.body: Accept time-limited opaque ticket links as the intended access capability for channel recipients, with the documented internet-reachability behavior.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the PR open until MCP App sharing has a broader owner-approved authorization model.

recommendation.title: Land tailnet-only first
recommendation.body: Permit the action only for Tailscale Serve and defer Funnel delivery until owners define the public-recipient security contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the paired transport prerequisite and the proposed Gateway/channel integration, so they are the best available technical routing contact for the decision.
